name: Polymer Testing and Properties
description: Properties of polymers and their measurements by standard test methods; tensile, flexural and impact properties; hardness, abrasion resistance; softening point, heat distortion temperature, thermal expansion coefficient and thermal conductivity; electrical insulation and conductivity; sorption, diffusion and permeation of gases/liquids through polymer membranes; standards used are BIS, BS, ASTM, ISO and DIM.
